name: csv-peek
description: /peek shows a CSV or JSONL file's columns, sample rows and inferred types without reading the whole file.

sampleKb.title: Sample size (KB)
sampleKb.description: How much of the start of the file /peek reads to infer columns and types.

maxReadKb.title: Largest full read (KB)
maxReadKb.description: A CSV, TSV or JSONL file bigger than this is refused when Claude reads it without a limit, and /peek is suggested. 0 turns the guard off.
